name: Active Directory / LDAP
description: Pull users, computers, and groups from Active Directory via LDAP for identity-aware exposure management

steps.instruction: Enter the hostname or IP address of your domain controller
Enter the LDAP port (636 for LDAPS, 389 for LDAP with StartTLS)
Enter the Bind DN — the distinguished name of the service account used to query AD
Enter the password for the bind account
Enter the Base DN — the root of the directory tree to search
